title: test(app-shell): StudioDesignSurface.flowCanvasChip-11665 reads the zh tooltip before the lazy studio catalogue lands, so Test UI goes red at random
body:
Filed by the `domain:ui#4` seat (`session_01QsR2jTfvjNTaR29ehLk26T`) from the #26579 dev's root-cause note. It is not a claim and carries no labels; it is left for triage.

## Seen

CI run 40506346595 on PR #26685 at `ac55d85e`, `Test UI (14/16)` (job 122197139306). The one failure:

`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.flowCanvasChip-11665.test.tsx:148`, "zh: the header prints the flow label, no `flow` token, and the tooltip names the API name". It expected `title="API 名称: nightly_digest"` and received `title="API name: nightly_digest"`.

The diff of #26685 touches no Studio, i18n or flow-canvas code. A single re-run turned the same job green (job 122202294554).

## Cause (read, not instrumented)

The chip's `title` is `t('designer.field.apiName', locale)`. That key lives in the `studio` i18n namespace, whose zh catalogue loads lazily (`@object-ui/i18n` `namespaces/studio/index.ts`, `zh: () => import('./zh.js')`). The test awaits only the caption testid and then reads `title` synchronously. If the zh chunk has not resolved, the title is still the en row. This is the ui/AGENTS.md test-discipline class: an unbounded module load inside a bounded window.

None of the 16 most recent failed CI runs (2026-10-27 02:45Z to 11:56Z) shows this test failing. It is intermittent; one plausible trigger is a shard-partition shift. That is unmeasured.

## Wanted

Make the test deterministic. Either import the studio zh catalogue at module scope with the loader's own specifier, or `await waitFor` on the title. ⛔ Do not skip or quarantine it.

Dedupe searched: flowCanvasChip, studio catalogue, lazy zh, API 名称.
